David Shepardson / Reuters :

 DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin says recent tech outages are not tied to cyberattacks but to “pushing new technology on top of really old computer systems”   —  The top US homeland security official said Tuesday a series of technology outages are not tied to cyberattacks but rather aging systems that are in need of upgrades.
